reference_description: Close-up photograph of a dropper closure assembly. The top component is a large, smooth, rounded rubber pipette bulb in deep aubergine/dark purple-brown color with a domed top and flared skirt base that sits over the collar. The collar/ferrule is a tall, polished rose-gold metallic cylinder with a mirror finish. The bulb is notably large relative to the collar, approximately 1.3x the collar width, with a soft matte texture and generous proportions.
output_description: Full-bottle render showing a tall cylindrical white bottle with a dropper closure. The top component is a small, dark purple-grey shape that resembles a flame or teardrop/finial — pointed at the top with a narrow waist and slight bulge, unlike a rounded bulb. The collar beneath it is a short, beige/cream-colored cylinder (not metallic, not rose-gold). The overall bulb is tiny relative to the bottle and collar, and has a pointed tip rather than a smooth dome.
top_component_observed_shape: Flame/teardrop finial with pointed apex and narrow waist — not a rounded bulb dome

component_semantics.evidence: The intent appears to be a pipette bulb but the rendered shape is a pointed flame-like finial rather than the smooth rounded dome seen in the reference. The shape does not match an exposed rubber bulb morphology.

visual_findings: Bulb shape is a pointed flame/finial rather than smooth rounded dome — critical shape mismatch
Collar is beige/cream plastic, not polished rose-gold metallic as in reference
Bulb is disproportionately small relative to collar and bottle; reference bulb is large and dominant
No flared skirt visible on the rendered bulb — it terminates abruptly into the collar
Collar height is very short compared to the tall, prominent rose-gold ferrule in reference
Color of bulb is slightly lighter grey-purple vs the deep aubergine in reference
Improvement over previous iteration: bulb now has a slight pointed top rather than flat dome, but this moves further from reference not closer
Previous iteration had a flatter, more dome-like top which was arguably closer to correct shape than current pointed version
critical_blockers: Bulb morphology is wrong — pointed flame shape instead of rounded dome
Collar material and color incorrect — must be polished rose-gold metallic
Bulb size severely undersized relative to collar width
Flared skirt at bulb base absent
